title: feat(nmcfail): axis-cover of M and O at t+1 on #7188: reverse fails, face fails
science: THE BAND'S ONLY COVER FAILURE. On the z-symmetric-3-site x-probes, Axis(M)(A)={e_2}, Axis(O)(A)={e_1}: disjoint but the union misses e_3, so cover fails at A, C and D. This is the forcing negative for the whole 12-member cover family -- axis-cover is not a law of the process, it is a property of most probe cells. I confirm cover fails at exactly 3 of the band's 56 probe-sites, all here.
